about_the_game:
Manage Your Dream Patisserie and Achieve Success!

Open your own cozy and charming patisserie, serving coffee, fresh pastries, and orange juice to your customers. Grow your business and increase your fortune by keeping your customers happy. Unlock new recipes to enrich your menu and decorate your patisserie to make it more attractive and profitable.

Manage daily operations, plan the kitchen work, and pay attention to every detail: prepare orders on time, serve fresh products, and make strategic decisions to grow your business. Expanding your patisserie isn’t just about offering delicious treats—it also lets you customize your space with decorations to capture your customers’ attention.

Experience the excitement of growing your small business and enjoy all the joys of being a patisserie owner. Create the sweet patisserie of your dreams, delight your customers, and turn your patisserie into a true success story!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 TI
  • DirectX: Version 12
